title: Preliminary Results on Cooperative Localization of ASV and AUV Using Acoustic Relative Positioning
authors: J. Choi; M. Kang; K. Choo; D. Kim; J. Park
key_contribution: Meets all SLR inclusion criteria for GPS-denied localization/navigation algorithm and platform validation.
